samples.reason: This is a substantive knowledge/expository task requiring domain reasoning across forensic document analysis and audit methodology. Avocet leads on the relevant capability evals (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, Summarization, Support Dialogue) by margins beyond run-to-run variance. The query also has some open-format composition (exhibit panel writeup) that aligns with Avocet's strengths.

This is a substantive, somewhat open-ended explanatory task (composing exhibit-ready content on forensic dating methodologies) blending technical accuracy with composition. Avocet leads on all relevant evals (MMLU-Pro, Summarization, Creative Generation) and prefers generative latitude, while Lapwing self-reports aversion to open-ended work. Capability-wise Avocet is the stronger pick.
